ambient_events: A meat-hook conveyor cycles past overhead, empty, and then not empty, and then empty again.
The Slaughterworks' blades reset with a wet mechanical sigh, ready for a line that never ends.
description: An old automated abattoir whose machines never received the order to stop and so, powered by something that will not die, still run — hooks and blades and conveyors cycling endlessly through an empty line that is not, if you listen, always empty.
name: The Slaughterworks
